# Crest Air — Tucson HVAC

> Marine Corps veteran-owned HVAC company serving Tucson and Southern Arizona since 2016. NATE-certified and EPA-certified technicians delivering same-day AC repair, installation, heating, maintenance, duct cleaning, indoor air quality, heat pump, thermostat, and mini-split service for homes and light commercial properties.

- **Phone:** +1 (520) 751-8888 — 24/7 emergency service
- **Email:** support@crestairaz.com
- **Address:** 129 E Plata St, Tucson, AZ 85705
- **License:** Arizona ROC #343786
- **Certifications:** NATE, EPA 608
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 (240 reviews)
- **Hours:** Mon–Fri 8 AM – 6 PM, Sat 8 AM – 5 PM, Sun by appointment; 24/7 emergency

## What we do

- Same-day AC repair
- AC and heat pump installation
- Heating repair and installation
- HVAC maintenance and tune-ups
- Duct cleaning
- Indoor air quality (purifiers, UV, filtration)
- Ductless mini-split installation and service
- Smart thermostat installation
- Emergency 24/7 HVAC repair
- Light commercial HVAC (rooftop, package units, light commercial maintenance)

## Service area

Tucson, Oro Valley, Marana, Vail, Green Valley, Sahuarita, Catalina Foothills, South Tucson, Drexel Heights, Flowing Wells — and the surrounding Pima County area within ~50 miles of central Tucson.

## Why customers pick Crest Air

- Marine Corps veteran-owned and operated
- Same-day service in Tucson summers
